prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent character portrait for a friendly Singapore nasi ambeng sharing game. Paint one fictional Malay-Javanese family member, with believable human proportions and a warm expressive face, in a polished semi-realistic hand-painted storybook style with delicate brush texture, natural skin, soft dimensional shading and warm earthy colours. This must read as a proper illustrated person with head, shoulders, arms and upper body, not an emoji, icon, chibi, caricature or floating head. Front-facing waist-up composition, looking slightly down towards a shared meal just out of frame, smiling naturally. Both hands loosely resting together near the lower waist, natural correct anatomy. Entire head and both elbows and hands fully in frame, centred, consistent scale, with 6% transparent padding on all sides. Square image, genuine transparent alpha background. Soft light from upper left. No scenery, food, plate, chair, table, circle frame, lettering, labels, watermark, logos or props. Contemporary everyday clothing suitable for a relaxed family gathering, culturally respectful without exaggerated costume. Subject: A grandmother aged about 75, medium warm brown skin, silver-grey hair neatly gathered in a small bun, thin oval glasses, gentle wrinkles and a kindly open smile. Wearing a muted lavender blouse with very subtle floral embroidery, modest neckline. Warm, dignified and welcoming.
